verdict: Pipeline is active; lead tracking is broken and being fixed now.
narrative: The 28-day dashboard shows zero leads, but that number is a tracking failure, not a campaign result — your CRM logged 41 new opportunities and 13 won during the same window, confirming business came in. Google Ads ran $1,080.52 in spend and recorded 12 conversions, while your Google Business Profile drew 105 actions including 28 calls and 45 direction requests, showing real local demand. Lead tracking is being repaired so the dashboard reflects what your CRM already knows. With an intake owner being confirmed by August 31 and Local Services Ads set to re-enable for heating season on September 1, the account is positioned to scale into fall.

highlights.phrase: new opportunities logged in your CRM this period, despite the dashboard showing zero
jobs won in the last 28 days per your CRM
Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: New leads are not flowing through to your CRM's automated follow-up, likely routing to an unassigned inbox since a staff change in July — 81 contacts are sitting with zero appointments booked.
watch_item.fix: Intake ownership is being confirmed by August 31, and the booking automation is being tested and corrected this week so no inbound lead goes unworked.
